rationale.conceptual: An established but non-trivial method (MP2 optimization, CCSD(T) single-point with counterpoise correction) that requires careful implementation, including proper specification of ECPs, basis sets, frozen cores, and ghost atoms. No novel algorithm, but the protocol is domain-specific.
rationale.execution: Multi-stage pipeline (~4-5 steps): geometry optimization, harmonic frequencies, CCSD(T) single-point energies with counterpoise, extraction of ZPVE, and computation of D0. Requires installing/configuring a quantum chemistry package, parsing its output, and managing multiple calculations correctly. Non-trivial but not extremely long.

difficulty.reasoning: The task requires reproducing computational chemistry binding energies via a standard MP2/CCSD(T) protocol with careful basis set handling, but no new algorithms. Multi-step pipeline with external quantum chemistry packages. CPU only, moderate memory, tiny data.

compute_estimate.reasoning: Small molecular complexes (<5 atoms per system); high-level ab initio calculations run on CPUs with modest memory (~4 GB RAM). Basis set files are tiny text files (negligible data volume).
